checks.name: RQ-018 definition unique du client actif
checks.definition:
checks for contrat:
  - ecart_client_actif:
      name: RQ-018 definition unique du client actif
      ecart_client_actif query: |
        WITH actifs AS (
          SELECT DISTINCT c.souscripteur_id AS client_id
          FROM contrat c
          JOIN client k ON k.client_id = c.souscripteur_id
          WHERE c.souscripteur_id IS NOT NULL
            AND c.date_debut <= '2026-10-01'
            AND c.date_fin >= '2026-10-01'
            AND c.date_derniere_cotisation >= '2026-07-01'
        ),
        directions AS (
          SELECT 'Commerciale' AS direction
          UNION ALL SELECT 'Sinistres'
          UNION ALL SELECT 'Risques'
        ),
        comptes AS (
          SELECT d.direction, COUNT(a.client_id) AS nb_clients
          FROM directions d
          LEFT JOIN actifs a ON TRUE
          GROUP BY d.direction
        )
        SELECT MAX(nb_clients) - MIN(nb_clients) AS ecart FROM comptes
      fail: when > 0

# RQ-013 : la valeur sentinelle 0 de assure_id est écartée par un filtre, sinon 40 % de faux orphelins

queries.name: crm.user_defined_query[ecart_client_actif]
queries.sql:
WITH actifs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.souscripteur_id AS client_id
  FROM contrat c
  JOIN client k ON k.client_id = c.souscripteur_id
  WHERE c.souscripteur_id IS NOT NULL
    AND c.date_debut <= '2026-10-01'
    AND c.date_fin >= '2026-10-01'
    AND c.date_derniere_cotisation >= '2026-07-01'
),
directions AS (
  SELECT 'Commerciale' AS direction
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Sinistres'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Risques'
),
comptes AS (
  SELECT d.direction, COUNT(a.client_id) AS nb_clients
  FROM directions d
  LEFT JOIN actifs a ON TRUE
  GROUP BY d.direction
)
SELECT MAX(nb_clients) - MIN(nb_clients) AS ecart FROM comptes
